english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a bank payment order.

exampleSentences.english: I need to deposit a cheque at the bank today.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我今日要去銀行入張支票。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 ngan4 hong4 jap6 zoeng1 zi1 piu3

english.note: Use this specifically for a bank cheque used to make a payment.

exampleSentences.english: I use a check to pay the rent.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 zi1 piu3 bei2 zou1
